headerDisplay:
Exposes your Alarm.com security panel and sensors in HomeKit.

If two-factor authentication is enabled — and it should be — supply the `twoFactorAuthenticationId` browser cookie (not a six-digit authenticator code). Capture steps: [docs/AUTH.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-myalarmcom/blob/main/docs/AUTH.md).
footerDisplay: Alarm.com may lock accounts that poll or sign in too aggressively, and a locked account also loses the Alarm.com app. The intervals below are enforced at safe minimums for that reason.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge log.

username.title: Username
username.description: The email address you sign in to Alarm.com with.

password.title: Password
password.description: Your Alarm.com password. Consider creating a separate, limited Alarm.com login for this plugin rather than using your primary account.

twoFactorAuthenticationId.title: Two-Factor Cookie
twoFactorAuthenticationId.description: The value of the `twoFactorAuthenticationId` browser cookie from a signed-in Alarm.com session. Treat this as a password: it bypasses two-factor authentication on its own. Leave blank only if the account has two-factor disabled.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to re-read all device state. Values below 60 seconds are raised to 60. Typical values are 60–3600.

authIntervalMinutes.title: Re-authentication Interval (minutes)
authIntervalMinutes.description: How long a session is reused before signing in again. Values below 10 minutes are raised to 10. Typical values are 10–1440.

useEventStream.title: Use push events
useEventStream.description: Subscribe to Alarm.com's event stream so sensor changes reach HomeKit within a second or two instead of waiting for the next poll. Polling continues as a fallback.

includeUnmonitoredSensors.title: Include unmonitored sensors
includeUnmonitoredSensors.description: Expose sensors that Alarm.com reports as having monitoring disabled. These are hidden by default because their readings may not be maintained.

ignoredDeviceIds.title: Ignored Device IDs
ignoredDeviceIds.description: Alarm.com device IDs to leave out of HomeKit entirely. Device IDs appear in the Homebridge log during discovery.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Emit verbose diagnostics. Credentials and cookies are redacted, but review any log before sharing it publicly.

diagnosticsInterval.title: Diagnostics interval (seconds)
diagnosticsInterval.description: Seconds between health/activity heartbeats in the Homebridge log. `0` disables (default). Values 1–29 are raised to 30; values above 86400 (24h) are lowered to 86400. Boot and shutdown snapshots are included when enabled. Credentials are never included.
